title: Merap language
extract: Merap (Mbraa) is an Austronesian language, spoken in the village of Langap in South Malinau district, Malinau Regency, North Kalimantan, Indonesia. Soriente (2015) classifies Mbraa as a Kayan–Murik (Modang-Bahau) language.
